description: Risk-first position sizing with quantity, notional, margin, effective leverage, fees, funding, breakeven, liquidation estimate, target R multiples and warnings. Use position_plan_on_chart instead when the user should see the plan on the chart.

feeBps.description: Fee per side in basis points. Default 4.

fundingRate.description: Funding per settlement as a fraction, e.g. 0.0001.

holdingHours.description: Expected holding time for the funding estimate.

maintenanceMarginRate.description: Fraction used for approximate liquidation. Default 0.005.

riskPercent.description: Equity risked if the stop fills, in percent.

targets.description: Take-profit prices and the percentage closed at each. Allocations should total 100.

name: position_calculate
